result.question: Why did leprosy break out on Uzziah?

readings.answer: Because the LORD had afflicted him
readings.support: because the LORD had afflicted him

readings.answer: Because he raged against the priests
readings.support: while he raged against the priests | leprosy broke out on his forehead

assessments.reason: Verse 26:20 explicitly says “because the LORD had afflicted him,” which is the same as “Yahweh struck him.”
Verse 26:19 states “while he raged… leprosy broke out,” indicating timing, but 26:20 gives the cause: “because the LORD had afflicted him,” so attributing the cause to his raging is not supported.

result.reason: The passage explicitly attributes the leprosy to the LORD’s affliction, matching the key, while the alternative cites only a temporal clause, not the cause.
